blurb: Stockfish 10 is the late-2018 classical release of the open-source Stockfish chess engine, originally forked from Glaurung 2.1 in 2008 and developed through Fishtest distributed SPRT testing. It pairs a tuned classical hand-crafted evaluation with aggressive late-move reductions, singular extensions, ProbCut, and continuation histories. Adapted to UCI over WASI from the pinned sf_10 commit and used as the default rating anchor in ratchet-ui.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build (Threads fixed to 1); no Syzygy tablebases (no filesystem in WASI).

features.label: Magic Bitboards
features.implementation: Plain 64-bit magic bitboards for sliding-piece attack generation.

features.label: PVS
features.implementation: Null-window searches after the first move with full-window re-searches on fail-high.

features.label: Aspiration Windows
features.implementation: Narrow root window from depth 5 with asymmetric gradual widening on fail-high or fail-low.

features.label: Null Move Pruning
features.implementation: Dynamic reduction scaled by depth and static eval margin over beta, with verification search at high depth.

features.label: Late Move Reductions
features.implementation: Log-log reduction table adjusted by PV, improving flag, killer or TT status, and move history.

features.label: Singular Extensions
features.implementation: TT-move exclusion search from depth 8 extending moves that stand clearly above all siblings.

features.label: ProbCut
features.implementation: Shallow reduced search on SEE-passing captures to prune clear beta cutoffs early.

features.label: Continuation History
features.implementation: Gravity-updated butterfly table plus 1-, 2-, and 4-ply piece-to continuation histories.

features.label: Tapered Eval
features.implementation: Packed middlegame and endgame score pairs interpolated smoothly by remaining non-pawn phase.

features.label: King Zone Attack
features.implementation: Weighted piece attacks, safe checks, and pawn shelter/storm terms combined nonlinearly into king danger.
